_comment: Row 724, the escape lens L2 measured: dropping EMPTY TARGET from p_bandcheck's BAD regex does not merely mislabel the refused target, it removes it from the DENOMINATOR (measured: (2,1,1) -> (1,1,0)), so classify() is handed a clean fully-examined tuple. The anchor is ZERO-WIDTH on the alternation decision -- lookbehind on the '|' after MISSING, lookahead on the EMPTY TARGET alternative -- so nothing value-bearing is consumed and row357 can classify it as structural. `new` is (?!), a COMPLETE regex token: an always-failing assertion that makes the alternative dead, which is exactly equivalent to deleting the term. An insertion that ran into the original text would report INVALID instead of CAUGHT; this one parses (verified in-process before running).
